zh-CN.title: 空间活动领取与计时
items: 八仙、蜘蛛侠等活动改由空间管理员领取，活动时间从领取时开始计算；永久 VIP 由系统自动安排
探索页现在只展示本空间已领取且仍在进行中的活动

en.title: Space activity claims and timing
items: Space admins now claim activities such as Baxian and Spider-Man, with each activity starting its timer when claimed; Permanent VIP is assigned automatically
Explore now shows only activities claimed by the current space and still in progress
